precedence.scope: This addendum supersedes only the Round 4 decision status and nextAuthorizedAction in active-change-control.json. All other requirements and blocks remain active.

hardProductLocks: Ticket-funded routine mass draws; ruby remains protected for evolution and selected pickup use.
N and R retain long-term specialist value.
UR is strong but counterable and does not dominate every axis.
Full skill cap requires at least twenty additional effective duplicates, with base-copy completeness and deterministic catch-up.
First reset targets 20-35 minutes and restarts at Floor 1 with fast re-clear.
Initial advertisements are rewarded opt-in only.
Limited combat content requires rerun, exchange, and pity carryover; permanent miss is prohibited.
First-day guarantee includes at least one SSR character and one SR-or-better weapon.
Initial product excludes PvP and competitive ranking rewards; tower records may be displayed without competitive rewards.
